description: Use this when the user wants papers on a topic, such as "find recent open-access papers on retrieval-augmented generation evaluation" or "systematic reviews on intermittent fasting". Pass topic words, and optionally from_year, open_access_only and a limit of up to 10. Asks Europe PMC and Crossref together and returns one merged list with each paper's authors, year, venue, DOI, citation count, free full-text link when the index confirms one, and the index it came from. Does not search arXiv: use search_arxiv for preprints. Does not check retractions or reference lists.

from_year.description: Only papers published in this year or later

limit.description: Number of papers to return, 5 by default

open_access_only.description: Only papers with a free full text; false by default

query.description: Topic words, such as "retrieval augmented generation evaluation"

name: search_papers

asOf.description: Date the indexes were read (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD); they are updated continuously

error.description: Present when status is not ok: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

notes.description: Present when one index could not be read

citedBy.description: Citation count in this source; sources count differently

license.description: License of the open copy when the source states it

openAccessUrl.description: A link to the full text that is free to read; null when the source does not confirm one, which does not mean none exists

source.description: The indexes the answer was read from

title: Search papers
